items.title: WeLion New Energy and its semi-solid-state batteries
items.content: WeLion New Energy is on a quest to make safer, better batteries. From the EVs that carry commuters home to the ships that transport goods across countries, more and more vehicles around us…

items.title: Form Energy and its iron batteries
items.content: Form Energy is building iron-based batteries that can store energy for multiple days. The company is ramping up supply at its factory and signing deals for commercial projects. New solar and wind installations produce electricity more affordably than fossil fuels in most places, but their output varies based on season, time of day, and weather.…

items.title: X-energy and its helium-cooled nuclear reactors
items.content: X-energy is developing small modular reactors to satisfy some of the planet’s most power-hungry users: industrial manufacturers that need high temperatures to produce billions of tons of concrete, plastics, fibers, and chemicals. Solar panels and wind turbines are great at producing electricity but what heavy industry also needs is raw heat—and lots of it. The manufacture…

items.title: Energy Dome and its carbon dioxide batteries
items.content: There’s a growing need for long-duration storage to meet energy demand and balance out renewables on the grid. items.title: Brimstone and its one-stop process for making cleaner cement and critical minerals
items.content: Brimstone is making strides on two industrial problems, reducing the emissions from cement and providing a way to produce more critical minerals within the US. items.title: WaveSave and its portable rubber dam
items.content: As sea levels rise and flood risks worsen due to global warming, WaveSave’s easy-to-erect portable dam offers a quick-response tool. People can use the dam to protect themselves and their property, and it can also store freshwater for later use. Communities in Europe, Africa, and Southeast Asia have deployed it successfully. items.title: BasiGo and its fleet of electric buses
items.content: BasiGo aims to replace the tens of thousands of diesel-powered buses on sub-Saharan African roads with electric ones that generate far fewer emissions.
